image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of an orangutan behind a chain-link fence. The orangutan has reddish-brown fur and is looking towards the camera with one eye clearly visible. Its left arm is raised, gripping the fence or reaching up, while its right hand is near its chest/face area. The background shows blurred green foliage through the fence mesh.

Ears are partially obscured by fur and angle, but visible portions appear small and rounded, consistent with species traits.

The fence geometry is mostly consistent, but some links in the foreground show slight irregularities in thickness and spacing, typical of AI struggling with repetitive geometric patterns.
